<<Zustand state machine>>
AgentStoreState- phase: AgentPhase
- thoughts: AgentThought[]
- plan?: DashboardPlan
- widgets: WidgetState[]
- sqlTabs: SQLTab[]

- flowNodes: FlowNode[]
- interrupt: HumanInterrupt+ setPhase(phase)
+ setPlan(plan)
+ addThought(thought)
+ updateWidget(id, patch)
+ addSqlHistory(entry)
+ reset()
